Title: HP FX900 Specifications
URL: https://hp.biwintech.com/u_file/photo/20220114/HP-FX900-Specifications.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
HP FX900 is equipped with a high-performance 4-channel PCIe4.0 master controller to better support the new-generation NVMe1.4 protocol. Its 5000 MB/s read and 4800 MB/s write speeds are about 1.6 times faster than the transfer rate of the previous PCIe generation. Perfect for avid gamers, overclockers, and PC enthusiasts.

> The faster speed of a new NVMe generation

#### Product Features

## HP FX900

PCIe 4.0 SSD > Born for gamers, enjoy a winning experience

> Max. capacity of 2 TB for all your needs

Designed for gaming, HP FX900 SSD provides higher bandwidth and throughput for heavy-duty applications and the large files required when you load a game. It saves time when loading programs, offers better system response, and brings an unbeatable user experience.

To meet the storage needs of professionals in gaming, content creation and data, FX900 comes in capacities of 256 GB / 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB.

The controller has a built-in PMU with high-quality power management to achieve multi-level power-savings and to prevent overheating, reduce power consumption, and extend the SSD lifespan.

> Low power consumption saves costs & extends SSD lifespan

The FX900 comes with graphene thermal pad for effective heat dissipation which works to keep the SSD s temperature lower, allowing (even though you re running at faster speeds) for more stability and optimal performance.

> Graphene thermal pad dramatically reduces heat

...

The transition to PCIe 4.0 enables a faster and more powerful generation of NVMe SSDs: the high-performance HP FX900 uses its PCIe Gen 4 x4 controller to support the new NVMe 1.4 high-speed protocol and ECC (Error Correction Code) based on 4K LDPC technology. Sequential read and write speeds can reach about 1.6 times faster than the data transfer rate of PCIe 3.0.

4-Channel PCIe 4.0 master controller

New-generation NVMe1.4 Protocol

Read speed up to 5000 MB/s

Large capacity of up to 2 TB

Graphene pad for efficient heat dissipation
